rulings: Mission per owner ruling 2026-10-21: the verb only, and it must fit both a mouse click and a finger tap; #211 precedent keeps 点击 as device-neutral. (1) map.lead.a, tmap.lead, plan.empty.d: 点击 kept verbatim; the blind reader independently confirmed that 点击 is the standard Chinese UI verb for both click and tap, and none of the three uses a mouse-only or touch-only verb. Rendering 'click or tap' as 点击或轻点 would be redundant in Chinese. (2) dining heroSum: 轻点即达 -> 点击即达. 轻点 is a touch gesture, so it fails the ruling; 点击 reuses the site's established verb (TM: 点击即可查看, 点击每个链接，即可直达) and keeps the four-character rhythm. Reader item 3 (点击即达 does not name what is clicked or where one arrives): weighed against the source. Arabic «لكلٍّ منها صورته وموقعه على خرائط قوقل، تصل إليه بضغطة واحدة» and English 'its place on Google Maps, one click or tap away' both leave the object implicit; it is the map location named in the same clause (谷歌地图位置), which 即达 resumes, exactly as the published 轻点即达 did. The reader's 点击即可在谷歌地图中导航 adds 'navigation', which the source does not say, and widens the edit beyond the verb. Kept, no judge edit; 1 point off nativeness for the slight ellipsis.
blind_disposition: 0 serious, 5 minor. Item 3 (点击即达 object): in scope, weighed in rulings, kept. Out of scope, published text outside the verb, no edit and no deduction, listed for the owner: item 1 map.lead.a 它的信息卡 reads slightly translated (suggests 其信息卡 / 查看详情); item 2 tmap.lead opening fragment 绿洲立体呈现 abrupt in running text (suggests 以立体视角呈现绿洲); item 4 plan.empty.d 现成路线 slightly odd since the route is built from the user's picks (suggests 生成一条推荐路线); item 5 heroSum 民间风味 less usual for food than 地方风味 / 家常风味; practical remark: Google Maps links need a VPN in mainland China (fine in Saudi Arabia).
